purpose: Vehicle energy evidence: historical totals, daily energy/distance/efficiency and a current charging-power snapshot.
primaryGoal: Understand the selected vehicle's energy consumption and charging evidence without confusing missing measurements, estimates or trailing-window coverage with measured facts.

dataSources.scope: Selected vehicle; inclusive calendar day count derived from workspace start/end, not actual workspace instants.
dataSources.policy: Key ['energy-stats', vehicleId, 'days:N']; enabled only for non-null ID; STANDARD staleTime; forwards AbortSignal; raw SI historical fields.
dataSources.limitations: Handler supports start-derived trailing days but no bounded historical end; used, charged and total energy response keys all alias stats.TotalEnergy (handler.go:146-148).

dataSources.scope: Selected vehicle current state; intentionally independent of historical range.
dataSources.policy: Key ['energy-flow', vehicleId]; enabled only for non-null ID; REALTIME polling; retry false; STATIC staleTime; forwards AbortSignal.
dataSources.limitations: Handler converts canonical W to legacy kW for AC/DC response fields, forwards EnergyRemaining without explicit conversion, supplies nulls for missing readings and no sample timestamp.

dataSources.endpoint: Indirect fleet lookup via useVehicles; endpoint not independently traced in this bounded audit.
dataSources.ownership: Existing workspace vehicle store and URL synchronization.
dataSources.scope: URL vehicle_id, persisted selection and known-fleet fallback. No page-owned vehicle selector.

dataSources.ownership: Existing header-owned workspace range and preferences.
dataSources.scope: /energy-flow registered in RANGE_ENABLED_PATHS at web\src\lib\workspaceScope.ts:46; canonical startInstant/endInstantExclusive available but unused by this page.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Three charts repeat source-state wrapper, table-column adapters and fixed-height frame configuration (614,690,738). All already reuse SectionState and EmbeddedChart; no second chart engine.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Keep existing shared owners. A small battery-local chart configuration adapter is optional only if it preserves all three series, names and chart IDs; do not create a speculative app-wide wrapper.

issues.detail: Inactive connector content is dimmed to opacity-30; unavailable nodes/rows use opacity-50 (196,224). Missing-value and N/A text becomes dimmer together with decorative chrome. Effective contrast is unknown, not measured failure.
issues.fix: Keep missing/unsupported labels readable with semantic muted text and localize status; dim only decorative cues when appropriate. Measure composed light/dark/forced-color contrast before acceptance.

accessibility.verification: UNVERIFIED: keyboard, focus order/restoration, screen-reader output, touch targets, contrast, forced colors and reduced motion.

states.loading: Summary retains six metric shells with OperationalBrief loading; remaining source shells use SectionState skeletons (SectionState:42).
states.empty: Each source/section gets localized EmptyState with refresh callback; no-vehicle state provides /onboarding recovery.
states.error: FatalError alone replaces source body; retained refresh failures show StaleRefreshWarning and keep neighboring historical/live facts (SectionState:34,44).
states.offlineStale: Paused initial source explicitly unavailable; retained paused/error sources preserved. Page uses existing useDataState per source and PageLayout dataSources.
states.unknownPartial: Missing flow readings show dash; either unknown charging operand keeps combined power unknown; unsupported motor/HVAC/accessories remain N/A, not fake measurements. Historical rows default to [] for safe iteration.

issues.detail: Efficiency chart drops every day whose efficiency is zero/null/nonpositive, while history retains the date. A non-finite positive value also passes this filter before scaleEfficiency returns null under a non-null assertion. Chart absence is not visibly distinguished from missing source evidence.
issues.fix: Retain dated gaps and validate finite measurements using the existing trust/display helpers; document the positive-only domain rule if intentional. Preserve current history and do not turn unknown into zero.

states.verification: Source branches inspected only. Authored regression cases are not runtime evidence and were not run.

visualIssues.detail: Active power connectors add a 12px colored boxShadow. Dynamic styles are legitimate, but dynamic glow remains unnecessary visual intensity. Three chart hues and colored DC/AC/HVAC/accessory rows amplify semantic noise for unavailable channels.
visualIssues.fix: Remove connector halo; use neutral surfaces and restrained semantic text/icons while retaining arrow direction, activity cue, values and saved chart palette. Do not reset user theme/chart preferences.

architectureIssues.detail: Page discards workspace startInstant/endInstantExclusive and derives only days from calendar dates (258-261), then requests trailing stats (267). Any two same-length ranges use the same query key/results regardless of actual dates, and rolling 24h loses instant semantics. The explicit unknown-period declaration at 420 is truthful mitigation, not bounded server filtering. Handler Stats at internal\api\energy\handler.go:59-67 accepts only start-to-now/days.
architectureIssues.fix: Integration owner must extend the existing endpoint/service/hook with both canonical bounds and timezone-aware filtering; page consumes exact workspace instants. Keep current explicit trailing-source disclaimer until bounded support is proven. Do not add a local picker or silently filter loaded rows.

architectureIssues.detail: total_energy_used_wh, total_energy_charged_wh and total_wh intentionally echo the same TotalEnergy source. Page summary presents Total energy and Total charged as two facts (427-430), although this inspected endpoint does not distinguish those quantities.
architectureIssues.fix: Preserve all current metric identities and inspect source semantics with the integration owner. Explain the alias in source context/review details; use distinct consumed/charged measurements only after coordinated backend evidence proves them. No invented independent charging statistic.

architectureIssues.detail: Live endpoint explicitly divides canonical W into legacy kW AC/DC responses, while EnergyRemaining is forwarded unchanged at 69-70. Page appends kW and kWh directly in its flow and power displays; EnergyFlowData has no unit metadata. EnergyRemaining generated UnitKindNone (signal_metadata_gen.go:1566) does not establish a canonical unit. Historical stats already use explicit SI and display converters.
architectureIssues.fix: Coordinate the existing live wire/type contract with SI owners: prove EnergyRemaining's source unit before converting, return explicit canonical fields and display through useUnits. Do not apply a guessed extra /1000 to current kW values or change wire/cache values in a cosmetic page pass.

architectureIssues.detail: Sorting normalizes unknown energy, distance and efficiency to zero (356-358), although rendered/filter values distinguish null. Unknown and genuine zero therefore compare as identical.
architectureIssues.fix: Use the existing shared nullable-sort policy or an explicit page-local stable missing-last comparator; keep source values unchanged and preserve date/default descending behavior.

priority.reason: Workspace-bound historical coverage and live SI/source alias truth need integration work before cosmetic modernization can imply accurate range or independently measured totals. Palette and nullable sorting are P2.

requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Coordinate explicit W/Wh source semantics and known/null readings; establish EnergyRemaining units and source freshness before any rename/conversion. Retain current vehicle ID key, independent live query, supported/unsupported channels and local trust-state rendering.

competingImplementations.detail: Local flow node/connector/row helpers are page-domain rendering, not a second chart/table/layout engine. Existing canonical PageLayout/CardGrid/OperationalBrief/EmbeddedChart/DataTable owners are reused.
competingImplementations.decision: No new shared visual implementation justified by this single-page evidence.

dataBehavior: Keep every source/section shell mounted independently.
Never fabricate motor/HVAC/accessory measurements; retain explicit unsupported N/A.
Preserve null distinct from zero, source-local refresh failure/paused behavior and independent retry.
Raw historical Wh/m/Wh-per-m values remain untouched in query/cache; convert only at display boundary using existing helpers.
Retain exact specialist whole-Wh efficiency scaling/rating thresholds and CO2 estimate explanation.
Keep raw daily date ordering/key and table loaded/filter/pagination controller; preserve mobile distance detail.
Do not infer custom-bound server coverage from a same-length trailing window.
Charts currently explicitly disable fullscreen and export; do not claim lost/available capabilities without exercising shared controls.
